info.title: Event Ticketing API
info.description: Part 6 implements GA/seated booking, expiry, local/test payment simulation, cancellation and ticket viewing. No real money, Kafka or public provider callbacks.

post.description: Implemented GA and SEATED booking. Same account/operation/key and canonical payload replays the original 202/body even after expiry. Seat UUIDs are sorted for hashing and locked individually in stable order; seatIds must be unique and belong to the event/type. Commit hold before responding. HELD seats remain unavailable until the expiry transaction commits. Overdue holds may return HOLD_EXPIRY_PROCESSING; inactive/not on sale returns INVENTORY_UNAVAILABLE; non-published/missing catalog returns404. Worker expires bookings with no durable payment result; recorded payment results are deferred until the T5 processor.

post.description: Implemented in Part 6. Only CUSTOMER owner; other owners get 404. requestId dedup scoped by booking; changed scenario with same requestId => IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED. DELAY_TIMEOUT records result at expiresAt + 1 second using DB scheduler, never sleeps holding locks. Only scenario/requestId are accepted; status, recordedAt, amount and identity are server-owned. The result and result outbox commit before the local processor runs. Retry the same requestId/scenario after network/503/500; processing failures leave the durable result available for recovery.

get.description: Implemented in Part 6. CUSTOMER owner or ADMIN; other owners get 404. Return [] unless booking is CONFIRMED; no tickets for EXPIRED/REFUND_REQUIRED. The opaque EF-UUID code identifies a demo ticket; it is not an offline signature or production QR. Nullable seatId/seatLabel describe seat allocation; GA uses ticketOrdinal.
